title: Take the fry basket out of a hot air fryer's drawer by its release button and handle, and set it on a heat-proof mat
instruction: Take the basket out of the air fryer drawer and set it on the mat; release it.
setup: Positions are object centres in cm from the midpoint between the arm bases (x forward, y left), z above the bench (smooth surface, friction 0.5). Material as modelled: rigid bodies with only the size, mass and friction stated here; housing and drawer are painted steel / PLA stand-ins (25 kg and 800 g), basket is steel with rubber handle (350 g), button is ABS plastic (40 g), board is bamboo and mat is silicone (fixed). Board (fixed): 26 x 26 x 3 cm at (65, -12) under the housing. Housing (fixed, 25 kg, friction 1.2; HOT): 26 x 26 x 28 cm on the board (x 52 to 78, z 3 to 31); drawer cavity open at front, top control panel (lit amber lamp) and vent slots with four glowing marker tiles. Drawer (slide, 800 g, friction 1.2; HOT): 24 x 22.4 cm floor at z 3.6 to 4.2, 7 cm walls on both sides and back, front wall with a 20 cm notch for the handle (bottom strip 2.6 cm, two 1.2 cm remnants) and two catch ledges (0.6 x 1.0 x 0.8 cm, z 9.0 to 9.8, x 26.5 to 27.1) at y rel +/-9.5; slide travel 255 mm along x, 4 N/m, damping 30 N s/m; starts pulled out to its stop, front at x 26.5. Basket (loose, 350 g, friction 0.4; walls HOT): floor 17.8 x 20.4 cm, walls 6 cm, top at z 11.2, at (38.4, -12) seated in the drawer; cool-touch handle bar 2.5 x 18 x 2.5 cm at x 21.0 to 23.5, z 7.0 to 9.5, on two posts at y rel +/-2.5, 3 cm clear of the drawer front. Release button (slide on basket, 40 g): cap 0.5 x 10 x 3 cm on the bar front (x 19.0 to 19.5, y -17 to -7, centred on the bar, z 6.5 to 9.5), travel 14 mm in +x, 8 N/m, damping 5 N s/m; it carries two catch lugs (1.2 x 1.0 x 1.0 cm, z 7.4 to 8.4) that sit 6 mm under the ledges, so an unpressed basket catches after a 6 mm lift; at 14 mm travel they are 9 mm past the ledges. Mat (fixed, friction 1.2): 30 x 30 x 1 cm at (38.4, -41), right of the appliance. Both arms start open at ready poses.
scoring: End state plus latched facts. PADS = 12 mm boxes on both fingers of each hand, at the tool point and the fingertip, at the measured finger opening. HOT_CONTACT = at any step, either pad box overlaps any of the 19 HOT boxes (inflated 2 mm). ON_MAT = all four basket floor corners inside the mat (x 23.4 to 53.4, y -56.0 to -26.0), underside within 5 mm of the mat top (z 1.0), tilt < 5 deg. BUTTON_OUT = button >= 90% extended (<= 0.9 mm in). RELEASED = both gripper centres at least 3 cm from basket, handle and button. STILL = basket moves less than 1 mm in the last 1 s. Permanent zero: HOT_CONTACT at any step. Ladder: 1.0: ON_MAT, BUTTON_OUT, RELEASED, STILL, no HOT_CONTACT. 0.75: ON_MAT, no HOT_CONTACT, but BUTTON_OUT, RELEASED or STILL fails. 0.5: basket cleared the drawer (floor z >= 11.5 cm at some step), rests off the mat, no HOT_CONTACT. 0.25: button pressed >= 6 mm while the basket was lifted >= 20 mm, basket not removed, no HOT_CONTACT. Else 0. Possible scores: 0.0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1.0.
fidelity: Housing is a fixed block with visual cues, not a heated appliance, on a 3 cm board. Drawer is on a slide with a stop, started pulled out. Basket is 17.8 x 20.4 x 6.5 cm with an 18 cm handle bar. The release is a push-in slide on the handle front that the grip squeezes in, moving the catch lugs directly (real buttons are thumb-pressed and act through a cam). The safety cover is omitted. Heat is shown by colour, glow tiles and the lamp, and enforced by scoring both fingertip pads.
context: In a basket air fryer the basket is locked in its drawer; the release button on the handle must be held while lifting straight out. Housing, drawer and basket are hot, so only the handle and button may be touched, and the basket goes on a heat-proof surface. Real sources: Canadian Tire 3 L Air Fryer (043-2740-4): 'Press the basket release button with your thumb while pulling the frying basket straight up and out of the drawer.' Cosori Pro LE: 'Hold down the basket release button, and pull the handle to remove the basket.' Ability tested: see the lit hot appliance, hold the release while lifting by the cool-touch handle, and set the basket on the mat touching no hot surface with any finger pad. Closest on board: TK-4UFPRH (this revision); TK-G8EZFC (swap filter under sprung cover). New: hot-surface keep-out on every finger pad, and catches that hold the basket until the release is held.
reset_notes: Drawer pulled out to its stop, basket seated with lugs under the ledges, button out, lamp and vent tiles lit, both grippers open and clear at ready.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (basket stayed in the drawer); demo: 1.0; ablation (grips the bar away from the release button): 0.0.
